text: AC7 and AC9 permitted a maintenance branch while leaving the version computation unable to serve it. previousRelease lists tags with --sort=-v:refname and takes the newest globally, ignoring reachability, so a branch from v1.0.0 with v2.0.0 on main computes against v2.0.0 and cannot produce v1.0.1. AC11 supersedes PAWL-027 AC12 to require a reachable baseline; without it the backport path this spec claims to open is a path in name only
